================================================================================
CQL with Batches: a batch is one statement
================================================================================

BEGIN BATCH
  INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (:a);
  UPDATE t SET b = 'x;y' WHERE a = 1;
APPLY BATCH;
select 1;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (string))
  (statement))

================================================================================
CQL with Batches: unlogged and counter batches
================================================================================

begin unlogged batch using timestamp 1
  insert into t (a) values (1);
apply batch;
Begin Counter Batch
  update c set n = n + 1 where k = 1;
  update c set n = n - 1 where k = 2;
Apply Batch;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
CQL with Batches: APPLY alone does not end a batch
================================================================================

BEGIN BATCH
  INSERT INTO apply (a) VALUES (1);
  APPLY; apply -- a comment
  batch;
select 2;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (comment))
  (statement))

================================================================================
CQL with Batches: a batch that is not finished
================================================================================

BEGIN BATCH
  INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (1);
\g

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (meta_command
    (command_name)))

================================================================================
CQL with Batches: BEGIN that does not start a batch
================================================================================

BEGIN TRANSACTION;
select 1; BEGIN; select 2;
select 3; BEGIN UNLOGGED; select 4;
create function f() begin select 5; end;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))
